auditor.name: M/s. SCS & CO. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Auditor noted multiple non-compliances: Board composition not duly constituted per Section 203 and Regulation 17; SDD software not maintained; Independent Director Ms. Tejal Kalpeshbhai Vohra is wife of Non-Executive Director Mr. Kalpeshkumar Vohra; no active CFO since 29.01.2025; website not fully functional per Regulation 46; delayed stock exchange and ROC filings; inability to verify director appointment/resignation forms; delayed upload of Regulation 74(5) certificate; delayed shareholding pattern filing; unsigned financial results initially submitted.

key_risks: Future development depends upon operational activities to be undertaken by the Company
Multiple regulatory non-compliances identified by Secretarial Auditor
No active Chief Financial Officer since January 29, 2025
Board composition not duly constituted as per Companies Act and SEBI LODR
Website not fully functional as per Regulation 46
Delays in statutory filings and compliances
facts.related_party_note: Ms. Tejal Kalpeshbhai Vohra, Independent Director, is the wife of Mr. Kalpeshkumar Vohra, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, which the Secretarial Auditor states disqualifies her from being appointed as an Independent Director.
